placementContract.physicalCoordinates: keep o.x/o.y/o.w/o.h and all existing obstacles, decor, roads, spawn and exit

generationWorkflow: Root attaches original board plus this exact object prompt to imagegen; generate only isolated front RGBA; inspect silhouette, alpha, material, dimensional ratios and no collateral UI.
Optional approved-front + original board → isolated reverse-view RGBA to verify coherent rear design; the reverse view must not redesign the object.
Root submits only the accepted isolated object image to Meshy Image-to-3D; these files make no API call.
Root measures GLB contact bounds/pivot, enforces uniform scale, checks front/back/roof/closed base and material alpha, then uses its verified native baker.

Native preview must be compared with the exact source board for material/shape; root checks collision footprint, height, sorting, .27 occlusion, phone/desktop and no UI obstruction before any integration claim.
qualityGates: Only one intended connected module, no village, no floor mesh or attached unrelated prop.
RGBA exterior truly transparent; wire-mesh and broken-pane holes not filled by a black background plane; opaque support backing remains where intentionally required.
Measured W:D aspect within3% of the specified contact box; all protrusions inside the box; visual height within5% of target. No nonuniform scale.

The source texture looks like reference ink and distressed materials at native game size; labels short and correct or left for native signage. No accidental English HUD/button/title or copied moodboard frame.
Front/back and ground pivot coherent; no missing rear, floating feet, low-poly silhouette substitution or dramatic perspective baked into mesh.
Ground shadow/glow/FX rendered separately; native ordering/fade/input/collision behavior retained.
Generated reference/model/bake and real-game visual validation remain explicitly distinct states.
